Planning Document: Marrickville DCP 2011 - 9 18 Dulwich Hill Station North

Clause 9.18.1 - heritage (heritage): The precinct contains part of the South Dulwich Hill Heritage Conservation Area.

Clause 9.18.2 - height_limit (development_control): To maintain distinctly single storey streetscapes that exist within the precinct.

Clause 9.18.2 - heritage (heritage): To protect groups or runs of buildings which retain their original built form including roof forms, original detailing and finishes.

Clause 9.18.2 - other (development_control): To protect significant streetscape s and/or public domain elements within the precinct including landscaping, fencing, open space, sandstone kerbing and guttering, views and vistas and prevailing subdivision patterns.

Clause 9.18.2 - other (land_use_zoning): To preserve the predominantly low density residential character of the precinct.

Clause 9.18.2 - environmental_protection (environmental_protection): To ensure that new development considers all potential impacts to biodiversity.

Clause 9.18.2 - parking (development_control): To ensure that the provision and location of off-street car parking does not adversely impact the amenity of the precinct.

Clause 9.18.2 - heritage (heritage): To protect the identified values of the South Dulwich Hill Heritage Conservation Area.
